name: IndiaNivesh Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1929, IndiaNivesh Ltd is in the business of investing & financing activity, acquisition and management of stressed assets and in other consultancy services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
INL is a financial services company registered as Non Systematically Important Non Deposit Taking Non Banking Financial Company and holds investments in its subsidiaries and other Group Companies. It provides:
a) Technical, financial and corporate advisory consultancy services 
b) Settlement / acquisition of stressed assets
c) Trading in Shares and Securities
d) Inter Corporate Deposits, Short Term Financing, Bridge Loans
f) Investment in shares and securities

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -49.4% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 100% of their holding.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.72 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 40.7 to 136 days.
